formal_object.rationale: SPD train-pool information H and finite cardinality k define a geometric selection objective.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: F06: Single-row logdet gain=log(1+x^T H^-1x). Condition: lambda>0 H03: Information coverage is not a guaranteed native accuracy gain. Condition: Finite train pool and declared count

derivation.rationale: The determinant lemma gives the exact log(1+x H^-1x) increment; finite greedy selection is not the global optimum.

assumptions.rationale: Rows/selection criterion are training-only; no test labels or hidden annotator access. Information interpretation requires a linear fixed-noise model; leverage may favor harmful outliers. Historical first-128 row policy cannot be changed as part of a source-maintenance patch. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: A train-index selector is explicit but parked: historical first-128 policy is retained, and a new accepted native design is required to change it.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Learning-curve benefit must hold at the same legal row count and include selection cost; geometric coverage and actual label quality can separate. Falsification: Random/source-stratified selection matches performance, or leverage concentrates harmful outliers and costs more than it saves.

closest_alternative.rationale: Known D-optimal/coreset and random/source-stratified selection isolate whether geometry helps task risk; high-leverage bad labels are a falsifier. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
